sentences.en: As Ukraine's counteroffensive grinds on, it's increasingly turning to a secret drone program that's hitting targets deep inside Russian territory.
sentences.zh: 随着乌克兰的反攻持续推进，它越来越依赖一个秘密无人机项目，该项目正在打击俄罗斯领土深处的目

sentences.en: Today, I talk to my colleague, Christian Tribert, about the origins of that program and to
sentences.zh: 今天，我与我的同事克里斯蒂安·特里伯特谈论该项目的起源，以及

sentences.en: Sergei Pritula, a former television host in Ukraine, who is now a key force behind it.
sentences.zh: 谢尔盖·普里图拉，乌克兰的一位前电视主持人，现在是该项目背后的核心力量。

sentences.en: It's Tuesday, September 19th.

sentences.en: Welcome to the show.

sentences.en: So, Christian, tell me about how you first came to investigate Ukraine's drone program.
sentences.zh: 那么，克里斯蒂安，跟我讲讲你是如何开始调查乌克兰的无人机项目的。

sentences.en: So, in early May...
sentences.zh: 所以在5月初……

sentences.en: Unverified footage appears to show an object flying toward the dome of the Kremlin before bursting into flames.
sentences.zh: 未经证实的画面似乎显示，一个物体飞向克里姆林宫的圆顶，随后燃起大火。

sentences.en: The whole world was in shock because these two drones attacked the Kremlin.
sentences.zh: 全世界都震惊了，因为这两架无人机袭击了克里姆林宫。

sentences.en: Tonight, there's a mystery in Moscow.
sentences.zh: 今晚，莫斯科出现了一个谜团。

sentences.en: The Kremlin accusing Ukraine of launching drone attacks, aimed at killing President Vladimir
sentences.zh: 克里姆林宫指责乌克兰发动无人机袭击，旨在刺杀弗拉基米尔·普京

sentences.en: Putin.
sentences.zh: 总统。

sentences.en: Ukraine denies it.
sentences.zh: 乌克兰对此予以否认。

sentences.en: And it was kind of like unthinkable.
sentences.zh: 这简直是不可想象的。

sentences.en: Of course, the Russian invasion, full-skill invasion of Ukraine had been going on for over a year.
sentences.zh: 当然，俄罗斯对乌克兰的全面入侵已经持续了一年多。

sentences.en: But suddenly, like, two drones exploding above the Kremlin was like, wow, they're hitting where Putin is in the heart of Moscow.
sentences.zh: 但突然之间，两架无人机在克里姆林宫上空爆炸，就像是，哇，他们在莫斯科的心脏地带袭击了普京所在地。

sentences.en: That was wild.
sentences.zh: 那太疯狂了。

sentences.en: Does Ukraine have drones that could reach the Kremlin, five, six hundred miles from the
sentences.zh: 乌克兰是否有无人机能够到达距离乌克兰边境五六百英里的

sentences.en: Ukrainian border?
sentences.zh: 克里姆林宫？

sentences.en: And it was surprising because Ukraine doesn't have equipment that does that, right?
sentences.zh: 这令人惊讶，因为乌克兰没有那种装备，对吧？

sentences.en: So, it was sort of like, wait, is this someone inside Russia doing this, a Kremlin attack?
sentences.zh: 所以大家都在想，等等，这是俄罗斯内部的人干的吗，是一次克里姆林宫袭击？

sentences.en: Who is this?
sentences.zh: 这是谁干的？

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 确实。

sentences.en: And that was the big question.
sentences.zh: 这就是最大的问题。

sentences.en: Like, who is responsible for this?
sentences.zh: 是谁对此负责？

sentences.en: And how could they pull off an attack like this?
sentences.zh: 他们又是如何实施这样一场袭击的？

sentences.en: Because Moscow is hundreds of miles away from the Ukrainian border.
sentences.zh: 因为莫斯科距离乌克兰边境有数百英里远。

sentences.en: So, was it someone inside Russia?
sentences.zh: 所以，是俄罗斯内部的人吗？

sentences.en: Was it Ukraine with some secret weapon?
sentences.zh: 是乌克兰带着某种秘密武器吗？

sentences.en: So, I'm part of a team called Visual Investigations.
sentences.zh: 所以，我是“视觉调查”团队的一员。

sentences.en: And basically, what we're doing is trying to find any visual clue that we can find.
sentences.zh: 基本上，我们在做的是试图找到我们可以找到的任何视觉线索。

sentences.en: Think of a satellite image.
sentences.zh: 想想卫星图像。

sentences.en: Think of a TikTok video.
sentences.zh: 想想TikTok视频。

sentences.en: Security camera footage.
sentences.zh: 安全摄像头画面。

sentences.en: Think of official statements.
sentences.zh: 想想官方声明。

sentences.en: You name it.
sentences.zh: 应有尽有。

sentences.en: To piece together.
sentences.zh: 将它们拼凑起来。

sentences.en: What's going on?
sentences.zh: 到底发生了什么？

sentences.en: And we try to do that with this attack.
sentences.zh: 我们试图对这次袭击也这样做。

sentences.en: There was security camera footage of those drones.
sentences.zh: 有这些无人机的监控摄像头画面。

sentences.en: One exploding and one seemingly hitting one of the domes of the Kremlin.
sentences.zh: 一架爆炸了，另一架似乎击中了克里姆林宫的一个圆顶。

sentences.en: So, we're like, okay, it's kind of grainy footage, but frame by frame.
sentences.zh: 所以我们在想，好吧，画面有点模糊，但逐帧来看。

sentences.en: Can we measure the wingspan?
sentences.zh: 我们能测量出翼展吗？

sentences.en: Can we match it to something that we have seen before?
sentences.zh: 我们能把它和我们以前见过的事物匹配起来吗？

sentences.en: And we couldn't really find a match.
sentences.zh: 我们真的找不到匹配的。

sentences.en: It was a mystery.
sentences.zh: 这是一个谜。

sentences.en: It was an absolute mystery, yeah.
sentences.zh: 这绝对是个谜，是的。

sentences.en: And so, then what happened?
sentences.zh: 那么，后来发生了什么？

sentences.en: So, as we're looking into this, me and my colleagues, right?
sentences.zh: 所以，正当我们调查此事时，我和我的同事们，对吧？

sentences.en: I get a text message.
sentences.zh: 我收到了一条短信。

sentences.en: And it's like, hey, Christiane, long time no speak.
sentences.zh: 内容是，嘿，克里斯蒂安，好久不见。

sentences.en: Would you like to know more about these drones that hit the Kremlin?
sentences.zh: 你想了解更多关于袭击克里姆林宫的这些无人机的信息吗？

sentences.en: Wait, who's the text message from?
sentences.zh: 等等，这条短信是谁发的？

sentences.en: It's a person that I've known for a long time.
sentences.zh: 这是一个我认识很久的人。

sentences.en: I haven't been in contact for years.
sentences.zh: 我们已经多年没有联系了。

sentences.en: Turns out to be this person that texted me is in this homegrown, do-it-yourself, long-range drone program.
sentences.zh: 结果发短信给我的这个人身处这个本土的、自制的、远程无人机项目之中。

sentences.en: Basically, a secret weapons program that's building a drone that can hit the Kremlin.
sentences.zh: 基本上是一个秘密武器项目，正在制造一架能够袭击克里姆林宫的无人机。

sentences.en: And I get a photo of a kind of like funky-looking drone.
sentences.zh: 我收到了一张看起来有点古怪的无人机的照片。

sentences.en: And I'm like, wow, this is interesting.
sentences.zh: 我说，哇，这很有意思。

sentences.en: I gotta see what's this about.
sentences.zh: 我得去看看这是怎么回事。

sentences.en: So, what did you do?
sentences.zh: 那你做了什么？

sentences.en: We started chatting.
sentences.zh: 我们开始聊天。

sentences.en: We started talking, mostly on signal.
sentences.zh: 我们开始交谈，主要是在Signal上。

sentences.en: But it's very secretive, right?
sentences.zh: 但这非常保密，对吧？

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And for that reason, people are extremely careful to talk about it.
sentences.zh: 正因如此，大家在谈论此事时都极其小心。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: They don't want to become a target.
sentences.zh: 他们不想成为靶子。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 正是如此。

sentences.en: So, it seemed the best way for me to better understand it was to just go to Ukraine to see some of these drones, to talk to the people involved in it in person.
sentences.zh: 所以，对我来说，更好地了解它的最好方法似乎就是去乌克兰亲自看看其中的一些无人机，并与参与其中的人面对面交谈。

sentences.en: So, I go to Ukraine.
sentences.zh: 于是我去了乌克兰。

sentences.en: And we're talking here about a very specific type of drone.
sentences.zh: 我们这里讨论的是一种非常特定类型的无人机。

sentences.en: On the one hand, it's long-range, so it can really cover those long distances.
sentences.zh: 一方面，它是远程的，所以它真的能覆盖很长的距离。

sentences.en: For example, from the Ukrainian border, hundreds of miles to the Russian capital, Moscow.
sentences.zh: 例如，从乌克兰边境到俄罗斯首都莫斯科的数百英里。

sentences.en: And secondly, these drones are one way and one use, meaning they take off, they fly towards their target, and then they explode on target, and that's it.
sentences.zh: 其次，这些无人机是单程且一次性的，这意味着它们起飞，飞向目标，然后在目标上爆炸，就这些。

sentences.en: That's the lifespan of the drone.
sentences.zh: 这就是无人机的寿命。

sentences.en: So, kamikaze.
sentences.zh: 所以是神风特攻队式的。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 一点没错。

sentences.en: And this is a pretty novel technology.
sentences.zh: 这是一项相当新颖的技术。

sentences.en: Ukraine wasn't known to have this.
sentences.zh: 乌克兰以前并不以拥有这种技术而闻名。

sentences.en: Very little countries around the world actually are known to have this technology because it's pretty hard, right?
sentences.zh: 实际上，世界上很少有国家被认为拥有这项技术，因为这相当困难，对吧？

sentences.en: You need to build something that flies for hundreds of miles and can then also carry a payload and needs to navigate through air defenses, electronic warfare, you name it.
sentences.zh: 你需要制造一种能够飞行数百英里，然后还能携带有效载荷，并且需要穿透防空系统、电子战等等的飞行器。

sentences.en: And what did you learn about how Ukraine managed to develop this technology that so few countries have?
sentences.zh: 你了解到乌克兰是如何设法开发出这么少国家拥有的这种技术的？

sentences.en: I mean, I don't think of Ukraine as, you know, cutting-edge military technology place.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我不认为乌克兰是一个你知道的尖端军事技术地方。

sentences.en: So, it all started in mid-October last year.
sentences.zh: 这一切都始于去年10月中旬。

sentences.en: And that's when Russia started hitting Kiev and other Ukrainian cities with kamikaze drones that they had bought from Iran.
sentences.zh: 也就是从那时起，俄罗斯开始用从伊朗购买的神风无人机轰炸基辅和其他乌克兰城市。

sentences.en: Today, we woke up to the sound of explosions in Kiev as the Russians launched a massive drone attack against this city.
sentences.zh: 今天，我们在一声声爆炸声中醒来，因为俄罗斯人对基辅这座城市发动了大规模的无人机袭击。

sentences.en: Kiev says fragments of this drone, shot down in southern Ukraine, have Iranian as well as Russian markings.
sentences.zh: 基辅称，在乌克兰南部被击落的这种无人机的碎片上有伊朗和俄罗斯的标记。

sentences.en: These are the type of weapons that the U.S.
sentences.zh: 这些是美国

sentences.en: and other Western nations allied with Ukraine are not willing to give to Kiev
sentences.zh: 以及与乌克兰结盟的其他西方国家不愿意提供给基辅的武器

sentences.en: because they're worried that Kiev will use those weapons sooner or later to indeed strike inside Russia with whatever the consequences may be
sentences.zh: 因为他们担心基辅迟早会用这些武器真正打击俄罗斯本土，无论产生什么后果

sentences.en: if you use Western weapons to strike Moscow, for example.
sentences.zh: 如果你使用西方武器打击莫斯科，例如。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: The Americans don't want to give the Ukrainians stuff to make these things
sentences.zh: 美国人不想给乌克兰人制造这些东西的材料

sentences.en: because that could prompt the Ukrainians actually striking the Kremlin and the Kremlin pushing the nuclear button.
sentences.zh: 因为那可能会促使乌克兰人真的袭击克里姆林宫，而克里姆林宫则会按下核按钮。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So, because of that worry, because the West not willing to give those weapons to Ukraine,
sentences.zh: 所以，因为这种担忧，因为西方不愿意向乌克兰提供这些武器，

sentences.en: Ukrainians were like, okay, we'll have to build them ourselves.
sentences.zh: 乌克兰人觉得，好吧，我们得自己造。

sentences.en: So, they got together basically anyone that has some idea of like, how do we build a drone and scramble together to build this capacity themselves.
sentences.zh: 于是他们把基本上任何对“我们如何制造无人机”有些想法的人聚在一起，拼凑起来自己建立这种能力。

sentences.en: But it takes, of course, some time.
sentences.zh: 但这当然需要一些时间。

sentences.en: And they start repurposing reconnaissance drones that are not intended to explode or to fly and hit a target.
sentences.zh: 他们开始改造那些并非旨在爆炸或飞行并撞击目标的侦察无人机。

sentences.en: And it seems like they're just trying to reach Moscow because here and there we see like posts on Telegram
sentences.zh: 看起来他们只是在试图接近莫斯科，因为我们在Telegram上到处都能看到

sentences.en: in Russian small villages and communities where they just find a drone which we identified as being Ukrainian-made in a foreSt.
sentences.zh: 俄罗斯小村庄和小社区的帖子，他们在森林里发现了一架我们确认是乌克兰制造的无人机。

sentences.en: I was being told by one of the people involved in a drone program, yeah, like, you know, sometimes we hit a tree or a power line.
sentences.zh: 无人机项目的一位参与者告诉我，是的，你知道，有时候我们撞上了一棵树或一条电线。

sentences.en: So, it doesn't really work or has the intended effect yet.
sentences.zh: 所以它还没有真正发挥作用或达到预期效果。

sentences.en: But then they also start asking publicly for money.
sentences.zh: 但随后他们也开始公开募捐。

sentences.en: Volunteer fundraisers start saying, hey, you know, we want to raise money for a long-range striking capability for Ukraine.
sentences.zh: 志愿者筹款人开始说，嘿，你知道的，我们想为乌克兰的远程打击能力筹集资金。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: So, it wasn't actually going that well.
sentences.zh: 所以当时其实并没有那么顺利。

sentences.en: They're starting to repurpose things.
sentences.zh: 他们开始改造各种东西。

sentences.en: The things hit trees, not going very far.
sentences.zh: 这些东西撞到树上，飞不了多远。

sentences.en: They need money.
sentences.zh: 他们需要资金。

sentences.en: And it reaches this kind of fundraising stage.
sentences.zh: 并达到了这种筹款阶段。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: But slowly but surely, it seems they're stepping up their game.
sentences.zh: 但慢慢地，他们似乎在加码。

sentences.en: And Ukraine was actually reaching a point where they can reach Moscow.
sentences.zh: 乌克兰实际上达到了能够打击莫斯科的程度。

sentences.en: And that's when the strike on the Kremlin happens.
sentences.zh: 然后针对克里姆林宫的打击就发生了。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: The strike that launched you on this reporting journey in the first place.
sentences.zh: 正是这次袭击开启了你的这趟报道之旅。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And it was very clear it wasn't a lucky shot because that same month, multiple drones hit Moscow.
sentences.zh: 很明显，这不是一次幸运的命中，因为就在那个月，多架无人机袭击了莫斯科。

sentences.en: And what are we talking about, Christian, in terms of the numbers of these strikes?
sentences.zh: 克里斯蒂安，就这些袭击的数量而言，我们在谈论什么？

sentences.en: What does your reporting say?
sentences.zh: 你的报道是怎么说的？

sentences.en: Well, where we saw, like, just like a handful in late 2022, late last year, we have seen the amount of attacks double in the past three months alone.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我们在2022年底（即去年底）只看到寥寥几起，而仅在过去三个月里，袭击数量就翻了一番。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: So, it's really increasing a lot.
sentences.zh: 所以它确实在大幅增加。

sentences.en: Like, I talked to one of these drone developers and he sent me a video.
sentences.zh: 就像我跟其中一位无人机开发者谈过的一样，他给我发了一段视频。

sentences.en: And this video shows one of the drones currently under production.
sentences.zh: 这段视频展示了目前正在生产的一架无人机。

sentences.en: And it has these very, like, significant sound.
sentences.zh: 它有着非常明显的这种声音。

sentences.en: Like, it's sometimes called, like, a flowing lawnmower.
sentences.zh: 有时它被称为像一台飞行的割草机。

sentences.en: It's a very, like, kind of scary sound.
sentences.zh: 这是一种非常吓人的声音。

sentences.en: I get that video and signal with the comment, this is going to be the number one hit track in Moscow this fall.
sentences.zh: 我在Signal上收到了那段视频，并附有评论：这将是今年秋天莫斯科排名第一的热门单曲。

sentences.en: Yeah, I mean, that sound, right?
sentences.zh: 对，我的意思是，那个声音？

sentences.en: It is terrifying.
sentences.zh: 太可怕了。

sentences.en: It's terrifying.
sentences.zh: 这太可怕了。

sentences.en: I mean, I've been in conflict zones where I've heard the sound of a drone.
sentences.zh: 我是说，我曾身处战区，听过无人机的声音。

sentences.en: I didn't know what it was immediately, but I learned over time.
sentences.zh: 一开始我不知道那是什么，但后来慢慢知道了。

sentences.en: And it's this sound that makes you feel like you are a tiny ant and there's a foot above you about to crush you.
sentences.zh: 这种声音会让你觉得自己像一只微不足道的蚂蚁，头顶上就踩着一只随时准备碾死你的脚。

sentences.en: Yeah, and I think it's a big part of why Ukraine is launching these long-range drones into Russia.
sentences.zh: 是的，我认为这也是乌克兰向俄罗斯本土发射这些远程无人机的重要原因。

sentences.en: Because, indeed, that sound, imagine being woken up in Moscow and you hear that sound and you're not sure what's going on.
sentences.zh: 因为确实，想象一下在莫斯科突然被惊醒，听到那种声音，却不知道发生了什么。

sentences.en: And it happens again and again and again.
sentences.zh: 而且这种事情一次又一次地发生。

sentences.en: And someone told me, let them feel the war.
sentences.zh: 有人告诉我，让他们也感受一下战争。

sentences.en: If you support the occupation and the invasion of Ukraine, you should not be able to feel safe.
sentences.zh: 如果你支持对乌克兰的占领和侵略，你就应该无法感到安全。

sentences.en: Okay, so it's scary.
sentences.zh: 好吧，所以这很吓人。

sentences.en: It might be rattling people in Russia.
sentences.zh: 它可能会让俄罗斯人感到恐慌。

sentences.en: But is it meaningful militarily?
sentences.zh: 但它在军事上有意义吗？

sentences.en: Like, has this program claimed credit for significant damages or killed anyone in Russian territory?
sentences.zh: 比如，这个项目有没有宣称造成重大损失，或者在俄罗斯领土上消灭了任何人？

sentences.en: So far, it hasn't killed anyone yet.
sentences.zh: 到目前为止，它还没有消灭任何人。

sentences.en: But I think we shouldn't underestimate what those drones have already done and could do in the future.
sentences.zh: 但我认为我们不应该低估这些无人机已经做过的事以及未来可能做的事。

sentences.en: Because we have seen in Peskov, which is pretty far away from Ukraine, at a military air base,
sentences.zh: 因为我们在普斯科夫看到了这一点，那里距离乌克兰相当远，在一个军事空军基地，

sentences.en: they were able to destroy two very expensive cargo aircraft of the Russian Air Force and damage to others.
sentences.zh: 他们成功摧毁了俄罗斯空军两架价值极高的运输机，并损坏了另外两架。

sentences.en: And besides hitting military targets like that, they've also hit infrastructure like oil depots, oil storage sites.
sentences.zh: 除了打击这类军事目标外，他们还打击了油库、储油设施等基础设施。

sentences.en: And this, of course, could affect the Russian military logistically when they're sending new troops into Ukraine.
sentences.zh: 当然，这可能会在俄罗斯向乌克兰派遣新部队时影响其军事后勤。

sentences.en: But besides that, Russia also needs to make decisions.
sentences.zh: 但除此之外，俄罗斯也必须做出抉择。

sentences.en: Hey, are we going to place our fancy air defense unit in the suburbs of Moscow and replace it from Ukraine?
sentences.zh: 嘿，我们是要把我们精良的防空部队部署到莫斯科郊区，还是从乌克兰调防？

sentences.en: And these are strategic decisions Russia needs to make.
sentences.zh: 这些都是俄罗斯需要做出的战略决策。

sentences.en: And that could affect also the battlefield in Ukraine, of course.
sentences.zh: 当然，这也会影响乌克兰的战场局势。

sentences.en: Oh, interesting.
sentences.zh: 哦，有意思。

sentences.en: So we have this fancy air defense stuff.
sentences.zh: 所以我们有这些精良的防空装备。

sentences.en: It's in Ukraine now.
sentences.zh: 它现在在乌克兰。

sentences.en: That's where we're fighting the war.
sentences.zh: 那是我们进行战争的地方。

sentences.en: But, whoa, maybe we need to bring it to Russia, which in itself would be an acknowledgement that, holy moly, something's going wrong, right?
sentences.zh: 但是，天哪，也许我们需要把它调回俄罗斯，这本身就等于承认，天哪，出大问题了，对吧？

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 完全正确。

sentences.en: Because it is a hard choice for Russia probably to make, right?
sentences.zh: 因为对俄罗斯来说，这大概是个艰难的选择，对吧？

sentences.en: Because are you going to defend your capital city, including the House of the President,
sentences.zh: 因为你是要保卫你的首都，包括总统府，

sentences.en: and including a very important military air base that clearly right now don't have full protection from these drones?
sentences.zh: 以及一个非常重要的军事空军基地——而显然目前这些地方并没有完全防范这些无人机？

sentences.en: Or are you going to leave it in Ukraine?
sentences.zh: 还是把它留在乌克兰？

sentences.en: What I understand from talking with sources in Ukraine's military intelligence agency,
sentences.zh: 据我与乌克兰军方情报部门消息人士的交流了解，

sentences.en: this is indeed what they're hoping to do, force Russia to make hard decisions where to deploy their air defenses.
sentences.zh: 这确实是他们希望做到的，迫使俄罗斯在部署防空系统时做出艰难的抉择。

sentences.en: And Christian, what's the big picture here?
sentences.zh: 克里斯蒂安，这里的宏观局势是怎样的？

sentences.en: Like, what do we think the ultimate effect is?
sentences.zh: 比如说，我们认为最终的影响会是什么？

sentences.en: I mean, I remember our colleague Mike Schwartz, you know, I called him when I first started seeing these drones.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我记得我们的同事迈克·施瓦茨，你知道的，我第一次看到这些无人机时就给他打了电话。

sentences.en: And I said, what's going on here?
sentences.zh: 我说，这到底是怎么回事？

sentences.en: I mean, is this important?
sentences.zh: 我是说，这很重要吗？

sentences.en: And he said, you know, one thing is for sure.
sentences.zh: 他说，你知道，有一点是肯定的。

sentences.en: This war will not end until it reaches Moscow.
sentences.zh: 这场战争不打到莫斯科是不会结束的。

sentences.en: Is that what we're looking at here?
sentences.zh: 这就是我们现在看到的情况吗？

sentences.en: Time will tell.
sentences.zh: 时间会证明一切。

sentences.en: But I think it's such a new thing to see that these Ukrainian drones are hitting Moscow, hitting Moscow now repeatedly and hitting military targets repeatedly.
sentences.zh: 但我觉得，乌克兰无人机正在袭击莫斯科，现在正一再袭击莫斯科、一再袭击军事目标，这种现象非常新奇。

sentences.en: And with it seemingly only to increase, we may seem that there is more pressure on Russian civilians,
sentences.zh: 而且随着这种趋势似乎只会加剧，我们可能会发现，不仅俄罗斯平民承受的压力更大了，

sentences.en: but also on Russian elites that are still close to Putin that will feel worried, like, wait, can it hit my house?
sentences.zh: 那些依然接近普京的俄罗斯精英也会感到担忧，比如，等等，这会不会打到我家？

sentences.en: Would they target my house?
sentences.zh: 他们会把我家当作目标吗？

sentences.en: And I think instilling that fear may create some change around people that are closer to Putin.
sentences.zh: 我认为，灌输这种恐惧可能会促使普京身边的人做出一些改变。

sentences.en: So you went to Ukraine, you found this nascent drone program that was largely built from scratch, and you watched as it became more and more effective.
sentences.zh: 所以你去了乌克兰，发现了这个崭新的无人机项目，它基本上是从零开始建立的，你看着它变得越来越有效。

sentences.en: And it's all based on this ingenuity and scrappiness that the Ukrainians have really by dint of necessity, right?
sentences.zh: 这一切都基于乌克兰人出于生存需要而真正展现出的机智和拼搏精神，对吧？

sentences.en: That's all they got.
sentences.zh: 这就是他们仅有的全部了。

sentences.en: But, of course, that same scrappiness comes with its own risk.
sentences.zh: 但是，当然，这种拼搏精神也伴随着它自身的风险。

sentences.en: You know, when a program like this is cobbled together, totally ad hoc, using private donations,
sentences.zh: 你知道，当这样一个项目被拼凑起来、完全是临时起意、依靠私人捐款时，

sentences.en: individual donations, funneled through multiple channels, things can get pretty messy pretty quickly.
sentences.zh: 个人捐款通过多个渠道汇集，事情很快就会变得非常混乱。

sentences.en: Like, you know, maybe the money stops flowing.
sentences.zh: 就像，你知道的，也许资金不再流入了。

sentences.en: Maybe people get greedy.
sentences.zh: 也许有人变得贪婪了。

sentences.en: There's a lot that can go wrong.
sentences.zh: 有很多事情可能会出错。

sentences.en: How do you see the program at this point?
sentences.zh: 你目前是怎么看待这个项目的？

sentences.en: Yeah, I think there's these different kind of groups that are all building different drones, and they're even maybe competing a little bit with each other sometime.
sentences.zh: 是的，我认为有各种不同的小组都在制造不同的无人机，有时他们甚至可能彼此之间还有点竞争。

sentences.en: There are two intelligence agencies in Ukraine.
sentences.zh: 乌克兰有两个情报机构。

sentences.en: We know the military intelligence agency launches their drone into Russia, but now the internal intelligence agency also announced they have a long-range drone.
sentences.zh: 我们知道军方情报机构向俄罗斯发射了无人机，但现在内政情报机构也宣布他们拥有了远程无人机。

sentences.en: So the equivalent of the Ukrainian FBI is developing its own program, even though the CIA already has one that hit Russia.
sentences.zh: 所以这就相当于乌克兰的联邦调查局正在开发自己的项目，尽管中央情报局已经有一个袭击过俄罗斯的项目了。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: But then outside of the government, you also have these private individuals and companies.
sentences.zh: 但除了政府之外，你还有这些个人和私营企业。

sentences.en: They're also all trying to develop their drones.
sentences.zh: 他们也都在努力研发自己的无人机。

sentences.en: And sometimes it went to a point that they don't really even communicate with each other, are not really aware of each other, what they're doing.
sentences.zh: 有时甚至到了互不沟通、对彼此在做什么根本不了解的地步。

sentences.en: And production needs to be rammed up if they really want to continuously hit Russia, because Russia is adapting.
sentences.zh: 如果他们真的想要持续打击俄罗斯，就必须加大生产力度，因为俄罗斯正在适应。

sentences.en: Each time one of those drones is downed,
sentences.zh: 每次其中一架无人机被击落，

sentences.en: Russia can look at the technology inside and say, okay, we need to make maybe adaptations in our air defense here and there.
sentences.zh: 俄罗斯就可以研究里面的技术，并说，好吧，我们可能需要在防空方面做一些调整。

sentences.en: So each time Ukraine needs to step up their game, and they need to basically have a larger capacity of these drones.
sentences.zh: 所以乌克兰每一次都需要提升实力，基本上需要拥有更大产能的无人机。

sentences.en: And the question will be, are they able to ramp up production like that?
sentences.zh: 问题就在于，他们能够这样扩大生产规模吗？

sentences.en: And what is that a question of?
sentences.zh: 而这又是一个什么问题呢？

sentences.en: It's mostly, it seems, a question of money.
sentences.zh: 看起来，这主要是一个资金问题。

sentences.en: And right now, most of that money is coming from this hodgepodge group of volunteer fundraisers.
sentences.zh: 目前，大部分资金都来自这个由志愿者筹款人组成的五花八门的大杂烩群体。

sentences.en: People that had little, if anything, to do with the military before the war started.
sentences.zh: 这些人对战争爆发前的事，和军队几乎没有什么关系。

sentences.en: Social media influencers, comics.
sentences.zh: 社交媒体网红，喜剧演员。

sentences.en: People who had basically zero idea of what a kamikaze drone was, and now they're at the center of this drone war.
sentences.zh: 那些对什么是神风特攻队式无人机一无所知的人，现在却成了这场无人机战争的中心。

sentences.en: After the break, we talk to one of the main figures behind Ukraine's emerging drone program.
sentences.zh: 休息之后，我们将与乌克兰新兴无人机项目背后的主要人物之一进行交谈。

sentences.zh: 我是温娜·刘。

sentences.en: I write the game Connections, one of the puzzles from New York Times games.
sentences.zh: 我编写了“连线”游戏，这是《纽约时报》游戏板块的谜题之一。

sentences.en: And I love horror movies.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢恐怖电影。

sentences.en: I love my dog.
sentences.zh: 我爱我的狗。

sentences.en: And I love trying to trick you.
sentences.zh: 我还喜欢试图捉弄你。

sentences.en: I'm Sam Mazursky, and I create the game Spelling Bee and Letterboxd on a daily basis.
sentences.zh: 我是山姆·马祖尔斯基，我每天创作“拼字蜂”和“字母箱”游戏。

sentences.en: And I have this thing called Chromesthesia.
sentences.zh: 我有一种叫做色觉联觉的现象。

sentences.en: I see color when I'm listening to music.
sentences.zh: 我听音乐时能看到颜色。

sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》的游戏是由像刚才你听到声音的那些人制作的。

sentences.zh: 我现在住在基辅，我是乌克兰最大的慈善基金会之一的负责人。

sentences.en: Your colleague Maria was just showing me around, and she showed me a corner where there were some weapons collected there.
sentences.zh: 你的同事玛丽亚刚才带我四处参观，她给我看了一个角落，那里收集了一些武器。

sentences.zh: 跟我讲讲那个吧。

sentences.zh: 她给你看的是我们称之为俄罗斯角落的地方。

sentences.zh: 那是我们在办公室里设立的一个小型博物馆。

sentences.zh: 那是一个摆满了军队给我们基金会带回来的战利品的地方。

sentences.zh: 像俄罗斯飞机被击落的残骸这样的战利品？

sentences.zh: 俄罗斯喷气式飞机和直升机的碎片。

sentences.en: We have some devices from tanks, like to say thank you for your help, guys.
sentences.zh: 我们还有一些来自坦克的装置，可以说是为了感谢大家的帮助，伙计们。

sentences.en: Where did you grow up?
sentences.zh: 你在哪里长大的？

sentences.en: Where was that?
sentences.zh: 那是哪里？

sentences.en: What was it like?
sentences.zh: 那里是什么样子的？

sentences.en: Well, I was born in Soviet Union.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我出生在苏联。

sentences.en: I grew up in the 1980s in a small village in the west part of Ukraine.
sentences.zh: 我在20世纪80年代成长于乌克兰西部的一个小村庄。

sentences.en: And that was time when we had no FM radio stations, when we had no YouTube, we had no Spotify or something like that.
sentences.zh: 那是我们没有调频广播电台、没有YouTube、没有Spotify或诸如此类东西的时代。

sentences.en: But that was time when in Soviet Union was not popular to speak Ukrainian language because that's the language of village people.
sentences.zh: 但那也是在苏联说乌克兰语并不流行的时候，因为那是村里人的语言。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: It was seen as not a very prestigious thing, fancy thing to be speaking Ukrainian, right?
sentences.zh: 当时说乌克兰语被认为是一件很不光彩、很不高级的事情，对吧？

sentences.en: Russian was the language everybody should be speaking in Ukraine.
sentences.zh: 俄语是乌克兰每个人都应该说的话。

sentences.en: If you wanted to build a good career, you need to speak Russian language.
sentences.zh: 如果你想建立好的职业生涯，你需要说俄语。

sentences.en: So I'm thankful to my grandma and my grandpa who teach me to read, to write, to count, and also to sing Ukrainian songs.
sentences.zh: 所以我很感谢我的外祖母和外祖父，他们教我识字、写作、算数，还教我唱乌克兰歌曲。

sentences.en: And after that, Soviet Union collapsed when I was 10 years old.
sentences.zh: 在那之后，在我10岁的时候，苏联解体了。

sentences.en: I started to be a student in 1997 in Ternopil.
sentences.zh: 1997年，我开始在捷尔诺波尔上大学。

sentences.en: And I started to work on radio stations when I was 17 years old.
sentences.zh: 在我17岁的时候，我开始在广播电台工作。

sentences.en: That was what I loved so much.
sentences.zh: 那是我非常热爱的事业。

sentences.en: And after that, we had the Orange Revolution in Kiev, in our capital.
sentences.zh: 在那之后，我们在首都基辅迎来了橙色革命。

sentences.en: Hundreds of thousands of pro-democracy Ukrainians in the streets today protested against the results of the presidential election.
sentences.zh: 成千上万支持民主的乌克兰人今天走上街头，抗议总统选举结果。

sentences.en: And I moved to capital on this revolution.
sentences.zh: 正是在这场革命期间，我搬到了首都。

sentences.en: This was time that I loved because many people start to speak Ukrainian, you know.
sentences.zh: 那是一段我很喜欢的时光，因为你知道，许多人开始说乌克兰语了。

sentences.en: And they start to love this city more and more.
sentences.zh: 他们也越来越爱这座城市。

sentences.en: And I find some friends here and they invite me to work on a big TV channel.
sentences.zh: 我在那里结识了一些朋友，他们邀请我去一家大电视台工作。

sentences.en: And I start to be a TV presenter of a morning show on a TV show.
sentences.zh: 我开始在一档电视节目中担任早间节目的电视主持人。

sentences.en: What was that TV show called?
sentences.zh: 那个电视节目叫什么名字？

sentences.en: Wake Up.
sentences.zh: 《醒来吧》。

sentences.en: Appropriately named.
sentences.zh: 名字很贴切。

sentences.en: Yep.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: That was my time of rising when everybody in Ukraine started to know who I am.
sentences.zh: 那是我声名鹊起的时代，乌克兰的每个人都开始认识我是谁。

sentences.en: Because I was those guys who helped them to wake up every day.
sentences.zh: 因为我是那个每天陪伴他们醒来的人。

sentences.en: And who told them that you are the best people in the world.
sentences.zh: 并且告诉他们，你们是世界上最好的人。

sentences.en: And I wish you good luck.
sentences.zh: 祝你们好运。

sentences.en: But I was a TV presenter in dozens of different shows.
sentences.zh: 但我曾担任过几十个不同节目的主持人。

sentences.en: Like, maybe you have also in the United States.
sentences.zh: 就像你们在美国可能也有的那样。

sentences.en: We call it Battle of Sexes.
sentences.zh: 我们称之为《男女大战》。

sentences.en: I was one of the most popular Ukrainian-speaking TV hosts in time when mostly managers on TV channels, they were looking for Russian-speaking presenters.
sentences.zh: 在大多数电视台管理层都在寻找俄语主持人的时期，我是最受欢迎的乌克兰语电视主持人之一。

sentences.en: And that's why I created my own comedy show, Varyaty Show.
sentences.zh: 正因如此，我创建了自己的喜剧节目《Varyaty Show》。

sentences.en: That was the first 100% Ukrainian-speaking comedy show in Ukraine.
sentences.zh: 那是乌克兰第一个100%说乌克兰语的喜剧节目。

sentences.en: And my son, when he was maybe six years old, he asked me once,
sentences.zh: 我的儿子在大约六岁的时候，曾经问过我一次：

sentences.en: Dad, do you have some superpower?
sentences.zh: 爸爸，你有什么超能力吗？

sentences.en: Because he was a fan of Iron Man.
sentences.zh: 因为他是钢铁侠的粉丝。

sentences.en: And I started to understand that now is a serious situation.
sentences.zh: 我开始意识到，这下遇到严肃问题了。

sentences.en: I don't want to disappoint my son.
sentences.zh: 我不想让我的儿子失望。

sentences.en: And I said to my son, I have a superpower.
sentences.zh: 我对儿子说，我有一种超能力。

sentences.en: And I want to show you my superpower.
sentences.zh: 我想向你展示我的超能力。

sentences.en: And I take my son with me to other cities where I have my show with my colleagues.
sentences.zh: 我把儿子带到其他城市，我和同事们要在那里演出。

sentences.en: And I told my son, look, what do you see?
sentences.zh: 我对儿子说，看，你看到了什么？

sentences.en: He said, many people.
sentences.zh: 他说，好多人。

sentences.en: I said, yes, there's more than a thousand people.
sentences.zh: 我说，是的，这里有一千多人。

sentences.en: And they all are different.
sentences.zh: 而且他们各不相同。

sentences.en: Men, women, young, old, rich, poor, with good education, without education.
sentences.zh: 有男人、女人、年轻人、老人、富人、穷人，有受过良好教育的，也有没受过教育的。

sentences.en: Some of them drive cars, some of them take bus to be on our show.
sentences.zh: 他们有的人开车来，有的人坐公交车来看我们的演出。

sentences.en: But now I want to show you my superpower.
sentences.zh: 但现在我想向你展示我的超能力。

sentences.en: And I made some jokes.
sentences.zh: 然后我讲了一些笑话。

sentences.en: And one thousand different people start laughing in one moment.
sentences.zh: 一千个不同的人在同一瞬间大笑起来。

sentences.en: And I just turned my head to my son and asked him, so do you understand which superpower I have?
sentences.zh: 我转过头问儿子，那么你明白我有什么超能力了吗？

sentences.en: And he was so impressed that his father can do some magic with thousands of different people.
sentences.zh: 他感到非常震撼，原来父亲能对成千上万不同的人施展某种魔术。

sentences.en: I can do it in one moment altogether.
sentences.zh: 我可以在同一瞬间让所有人一起做到这一点。

sentences.en: But that was enough for me that I'm also a cool man like Iron Man.
sentences.zh: 但这就足够让我觉得自己也像钢铁侠一样酷了。

sentences.en: Yep, yep, I try my best for my kids.
sentences.zh: 对，对，我为了孩子们在尽最大努力。

sentences.en: They are also a big motivation for me to do my job here in our foundation better every day.
sentences.zh: 他们也是我每天在这里的基金会把工作做得更好的巨大动力。

sentences.en: Because I really miss them and I want them to come back to Kiev, to our apartments, where I feel myself absolutely broken because I'm alone.
sentences.zh: 因为我真的很想念他们，我希望他们能回到基辅，回到我们的公寓里——在那里我因为孤身一人而感到彻底崩溃。

sentences.en: Where are they now, Sergei?
sentences.zh: 谢尔盖，他们现在在哪里？

sentences.en: In a more safety place.
sentences.zh: 在一个更安全的地方。

sentences.en: In a more safe place.
sentences.zh: 在一个更加安全的地方。

sentences.en: Yep.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And also I understand that our foundation, all work that we do here to support our military, that it makes Russian secret services also not happy.
sentences.zh: 我也明白，我们的基金会，我们在这里为支持军队所做的一切工作，也让俄罗斯秘密情报机构很不高兴。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Interested in your location and your foundation, right?
sentences.zh: 他们对你的所在地和你的基金会很感兴趣，对吧？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And that's why it's also about to protect my kids because it's really dangerous for them to stay with me in Kiev.
sentences.zh: 正因如此，这也是为了保护我的孩子，因为让他们和我一起呆在基辅真的很危险。

sentences.en: Sergei, tell me about Russia and your relationship with Russia.
sentences.zh: 谢尔盖，跟我聊聊俄罗斯以及你与俄罗斯的关系。

sentences.en: One year and a half ago, when Russia started full-scale evasion, I shoot a video.
sentences.zh: 一年半前，当俄罗斯开始全面入侵时，我拍了一段视频。

sentences.en: Where I call to Russian TV stars, pop stars, because I know dozens and dozens of them by myself.
sentences.zh: 我在视频中呼吁俄罗斯的电视明星、流行歌星，因为我自己就认识他们当中的几十个人。

sentences.en: I said, please, you have millions and millions followers in your social media.
sentences.zh: 我说，拜托，你们在社交媒体上有几千万的粉丝。

sentences.en: You have dozens of millions of people of your audience who love you and who trust you.
sentences.zh: 你们有几千万喜爱你们、信任你们的受众。

sentences.en: And your army killing your audience in Ukraine.
sentences.zh: 而你们的军队正在乌克兰杀害你们的受众。

sentences.en: People who bring you money and people who applaud you on your shows.
sentences.zh: 那些给你们送钱、在你们的演出中为你们喝彩的人。

sentences.en: And if you will call your people to stop this invasion.
sentences.zh: 如果你们呼吁你们的人民停止这场入侵。

sentences.en: But no one said stop this war.
sentences.zh: 但没有人说停止这场战争。

sentences.en: And what did you make of that?
sentences.zh: 对此你作何感想？

sentences.en: Just forget about them and start to do my job, what I can do better.
sentences.zh: 忘掉他们，开始做我自己的工作，做我更擅长的事。

sentences.en: I like to unite people, to try to organize people with some crowdfunding campaigns to raise money and to help destroy Russian troops.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢把人们团结起来，尝试通过一些众筹活动来组织大家筹集资金，帮助消灭俄罗斯军队。

sentences.en: And the motto of our foundation is invincible when united.
sentences.zh: 我们基金会的座右铭是“团结即无敌”。

sentences.en: So you set up a foundation.
sentences.zh: 所以你成立了一个基金会。

sentences.en: Can you tell me about the moment that you started raising money for the drones?
sentences.zh: 你能跟我讲讲你开始为无人机筹款的那一刻吗？

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: So there was a situation in October last year.
sentences.zh: 那是去年十月份的一个情况。

sentences.en: My wife visited me in Kiev.
sentences.zh: 我的妻子在基辅来看望我。

sentences.en: And in the window of our apartments, she just watched like Russian missile destroyed house a few hundred meters from our home.
sentences.zh: 透过我们公寓的窗户，她亲眼看着俄罗斯导弹炸毁了离我们家几百米远的一栋房子。

sentences.en: And she was afraid and we ran to the bomb shelter.
sentences.zh: 她很害怕，我们跑进了防空洞。

sentences.en: And I was sitting there and I read in Facebook and in Twitter, thousands and thousands of Ukrainians.
sentences.zh: 我坐在那里，在脸书和推特上看到成千上万的乌克兰人。

sentences.en: They were in fury because Russia attacked Ukraine with dozens and dozens of missiles.
sentences.zh: 他们愤怒至极，因为俄罗斯用几十枚导弹袭击了乌克兰。

sentences.en: That was a terrible day in our history.
sentences.zh: 那是我们历史上可怕的一天。

sentences.en: And people were so angry with this Russian attack.
sentences.zh: 人们对俄罗斯的这次袭击感到无比愤怒。

sentences.en: What were you feeling?
sentences.zh: 你当时有什么感觉？

sentences.en: That's a hard question because many different things you think during missiles destroyed your city.
sentences.zh: 这是一个艰难的问题，当导弹摧毁你的城市时，你会想到很多不同的事情。

sentences.en: Because one missile was exactly a few minutes from kindergarten where my daughter was, God bless, not at this moment.
sentences.zh: 因为其中一枚导弹落下的地方离我女儿的幼儿园只有几分钟的距离，谢天谢地，她当时不在那里。

sentences.en: But she will never visit this kindergarten is destroyed.
sentences.zh: 但她再也去不了这个被毁掉的幼儿园了。

sentences.en: So that's some emotions like, of course, you're afraid because I want to be sincere with you.
sentences.zh: 所以这带来了一些情绪，当然，你会感到害怕，因为我想对你坦诚。

sentences.en: It's really bad emotion when you understand that next missile can kill you and your wife.
sentences.zh: 当你意识到下一枚导弹可能会杀死你和你的妻子时，这种感觉真的很糟糕。

sentences.en: And, of course, I was angry with myself because you can do nothing.
sentences.zh: 当然，我也对自己的无能为力感到愤怒。

sentences.en: You have no power to protect your city.
sentences.zh: 你没有能力保护你的城市。

sentences.en: Your family.
sentences.zh: 保护你的家人。

sentences.en: Yes, and you're angry also with all our partners from abroad because they are so slowly with air defense systeMs.
sentences.zh: 是的，你也会对我们所有的海外盟友感到愤怒，因为他们在防空系统方面动作太慢了。

sentences.en: And our partners support us.
sentences.zh: 我们的盟友支持我们。

sentences.en: And we're really thankful for all help that we have.
sentences.zh: 我们对得到的所有帮助都深表感激。

sentences.en: Thanks for all tanks, APCs, guns, everything else, artillery systeMs.
sentences.zh: 感谢所有的坦克、装甲运兵车、枪支以及其他一切，感谢火炮系统。

sentences.en: But it's not enough because we have a war with Russia.
sentences.zh: 但这还不够，因为我们在与俄罗斯进行战争。

sentences.en: So after that, you're trying to find some way how to, what you can do at this moment.
sentences.zh: 所以在那之后，你试图寻找某种方法，看看此时此刻你能做些什么。

sentences.en: So we start confining campaign.
sentences.zh: 于是我们发起了筹款活动。

sentences.en: And how did you do it?
sentences.zh: 你是怎么做到的？

sentences.en: Was it just something you put on Facebook or what was it?
sentences.zh: 这只是你发在脸书上的东西，还是别的什么？

sentences.en: Facebook, Instagram, Twitter, YouTube.
sentences.zh: 脸书、Instagram、推特、优兔。

sentences.en: And we raise a little bit less, 10 million USD in one day.
sentences.zh: 我们在一天之内筹集了略少于1000万美元的资金。

sentences.en: You raise 10 million US dollars in one day.
sentences.zh: 你们在一天之内筹集了1000万美元。

sentences.en: A little bit less, maybe 9.6.
sentences.zh: 稍微少一点，也许是960万。

sentences.en: And we call this campaign for revenge.
sentences.zh: 我们将这次活动命名为“复仇”。

sentences.en: For revenge.
sentences.zh: 为了复仇。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: We tell people that we will find some way how to revenge.
sentences.zh: 我们告诉人们，我们会想办法复仇。

sentences.en: And that's why we choose drones with long range.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么我们选择了远程无人机。

sentences.en: And we bought big UAVs, kamikaze also.
sentences.zh: 我们还购买了大型无人机，也就是神风特攻队无人机。

sentences.en: There's like one-way tickets to Russians.
sentences.zh: 对俄罗斯人来说就像是一张单程票。

sentences.en: Did you have any previous experience with drones, Sergei?
sentences.zh: 谢尔盖，你以前有过使用无人机的经验吗？

sentences.en: Anything in your normal civilian life that would have brought you in contact with them?
sentences.zh: 在你平常的平民生活中，有什么事会让你接触到它们吗？

sentences.en: Of course not.
sentences.zh: 当然没有。

sentences.en: Of course not.
sentences.zh: 当然没有。

sentences.en: Oh, no, no, no, no.
sentences.zh: 噢，不，不，不，不。

sentences.en: Sorry.
sentences.zh: 抱歉。

sentences.en: Once, once during my wedding, there was like cameraman, but not with camera, but with drone.
sentences.zh: 有一次，在我婚礼期间，有个摄像师，不是用相机，而是用无人机。

sentences.en: So he filmed our wedding party with drones.
sentences.zh: 所以他用无人机拍摄了我们的婚礼派对。

sentences.en: So that was only one of my experience.
sentences.zh: 所以这就是我仅有的经验。

sentences.en: That was your experience.
sentences.zh: 那是你的经验。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: But if you want to survive, you will develop your skills.
sentences.zh: 但如果你想活下去，你就会发展你的技能。

sentences.en: No one here in my foundation had no such experience like we start to have after full-scale invasion.
sentences.zh: 我基金里的所有人，在此之前都没有我们在全面爆发后开始拥有的这种经验。

sentences.en: I have architectures here.
sentences.zh: 我这里有建筑师。

sentences.en: I have guys from IT business also.
sentences.zh: 我也有来自IT行业的小伙子们。

sentences.en: I'm a TV presenter.
sentences.zh: 我是一名电视主持人。

sentences.en: I didn't know one year and a half ago that I will raise more than $130 million in next one year and a half.
sentences.zh: 一年半前我根本不知道，在接下来的这一年半里我能筹集到超过1.3亿美元。

sentences.en: But that's a total war, and we need to do everything we can to support our soldiers.
sentences.zh: 但这是一场全面战争，我们需要竭尽所能支持我们的士兵。

sentences.en: Sergei, I guess I'm curious what you think is the most important role that long-range drones are playing right now.
sentences.zh: 谢尔盖，我想我很好奇，你认为远程无人机目前发挥的最重要的作用是什么？

sentences.en: Like, is the objective to destroy buildings or even kill people?
sentences.zh: 比如说，其目的是摧毁建筑物还是甚至杀伤人员？

sentences.en: Mostly, drones don't kill people.
sentences.zh: 大多数情况下，无人机不杀人。

sentences.en: They destroy some infrastructure buildings or some military objects.
sentences.zh: 它们摧毁一些基础设施建筑或一些军事目标。

sentences.en: I heard, maybe you heard also a few days ago in the Russian city, Psyko, four big Russian jets were burning.
sentences.zh: 我听说，也许你也听说过，几天前在俄罗斯城市普斯科夫，四架大型俄罗斯喷气式飞机着火了。

sentences.en: I don't know how it happened.
sentences.zh: 我不知道这是怎么发生的。

sentences.en: Maybe someone smoked in the not right place.
sentences.zh: 也许有人在不该吸烟的地方吸烟了。

sentences.en: But some people told me that maybe, maybe it was happening because of drones' attack.
sentences.zh: 但有些人告诉我，也许，这可能是由于无人机袭击造成的。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: I myself, Sergei, wrote a news headline about that.
sentences.zh: 谢尔盖，我自己就为此写过一条新闻标题。

sentences.en: And the news headline I wrote was that drones struck in many regions of Russia overnight,
sentences.zh: 我写的新闻标题是，无人机一夜之间袭击了俄罗斯的许多地区，

sentences.en: hitting and destroying four large aircraft in the Psykov region.
sentences.zh: 击中并摧毁了普斯科夫地区的四架大型飞机。

sentences.en: So, we said it was underscoring the Ukrainians' ability to reach deep inside Russia with the war effort.
sentences.zh: 所以，我们说这彰显了乌克兰人通过战争手段深入俄罗斯腹地的能力。

sentences.en: Deeper and deeper.
sentences.zh: 越来越深入。

sentences.en: It's really very important, Russians, to start to feel the same emotions like Ukrainians.
sentences.zh: 让俄罗斯人开始感受到与乌克兰人相同的情绪，这真的非常重要。

sentences.en: If you will stay in Bob's shelter every night with your kids, maybe you will ask some questions to your government.
sentences.zh: 如果你每天晚上都和孩子一起呆在防空洞里，也许你会向你的政府提出一些问题。

sentences.en: Maybe.
sentences.zh: 也许吧。

sentences.en: Is part of the power of these long-range drones that you're able to take this war to Russia and possibly awaken them to this war,
sentences.zh: 这些远程无人机力量的一部分，是否在于你们能够将这场战争带到俄罗斯，并可能唤醒他们面对这场战争，

sentences.en: as you were unsuccessfully trying to do when you were trying to appeal to Russian celebrities?
sentences.zh: 正如你当初试图呼吁俄罗斯名流时却未能成功做到的那样？

sentences.en: Yep.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: To send a message to Russian society that two can play this game.
sentences.zh: 向俄罗斯社会传达一个信号：这种游戏双方都能玩。

sentences.en: Have you seen any signs that it's working?
sentences.zh: 你看到任何这正在起作用的迹象了吗？

sentences.en: That the drones are breaking through to Russians in this way?
sentences.zh: 我是说无人机正以这种方式打动俄罗斯人？

sentences.en: Yes, of course.
sentences.zh: 是的，当然。

sentences.en: We are searching Russian media or Telegram channels and we find information that everything, everything work.
sentences.zh: 我们正在搜索俄罗斯媒体或电报频道，我们发现一切，一切都起作用了。

sentences.en: Everything work, meaning the drones that you funded hit their targets?
sentences.zh: 一切都起作用，意思是你们资助的无人机击中了目标？

sentences.en: Yes, ma'am.
sentences.zh: 是的，女士。

sentences.en: The drones that hit in Pskov, were those the drones that you funded?
sentences.zh: 在普斯科夫打击的无人机，是你们资助的那些无人机吗？

sentences.en: I didn't tell you nothing about Pskov and about our drones,
sentences.zh: 我没有对你透露任何关于普斯科夫和我们无人机的事，

sentences.en: but just believe me that I'm happy how our military used our drones that we bought after the crowdfunding campaign for revenge.
sentences.zh: 但请相信我，我很高兴我们的军方如何使用我们在众筹活动后购买的无人机来进行复仇。

sentences.en: Look, I'm a citizen of Ukraine.
sentences.zh: 听着，我是乌克兰公民。

sentences.en: I want to live in a better country.
sentences.zh: 我想生活在一个更好的国家。

sentences.en: I want to come back to my previous life.
sentences.zh: 我想回到我以前的生活。

sentences.en: I want my family back to Ukraine.
sentences.zh: 我想让我的家人回到乌克兰。

sentences.en: I want my people to stop dying with this war.
sentences.zh: 我希望我的同胞不再在这场战争中死去。

sentences.en: That's why that's not my choice.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么这不是我的选择。

sentences.en: That's my duty to do everything that I can do till the victory day.
sentences.zh: 直到胜利日为止，尽我所能去做一切是我的责任。

sentences.en: Ukraine's president, Vladimir Zelensky, visits the United States this week, his second trip since Russia invaded last year.
sentences.zh: 乌克兰总统弗拉基米尔·泽连斯基将于本周访问美国，这是他自去年俄罗斯入侵以来的第二次访问。

sentences.en: He will attend the U.N.
